hideHint: Hide from future wallpapers in Pinpaper. Pinterest is not changed.
getStarted: Add pictures from Pinterest to get started.
selectedEmpty: Choose a collection and add pictures in Settings first.
signInGuide: Open Pinterest below. Sign in with your email and password and complete any verification. Then return to Pinpaper.
privateHint: Sign-in lasts while the Pinterest window is open. After closing it, sign in again; your added pictures stay saved.
homeGuide: In the Pinterest window, open Home. Scroll down until pictures have loaded, then scroll a little more to load the ones you want. Leave that window open and come back here.
savedGuide: In Pinterest, open your profile → Saved. Open a board so you can see individual pins, not just board covers. Scroll down and wait for the pictures to load. Leave that window open and return here.
addGuide: Keep the Pinterest window open on those pictures. Click below to add up to 200 loaded pictures. You can then close Pinterest and choose a wallpaper.
addedNotice: Pictures added and saved. No need to apply the selection or save settings again. Go back and choose Change wallpaper.
retryHelp: If something did not work, return to step 1 and try the three steps again.
collectionsHint: Check the collections for future wallpapers, then apply your selection. All pictures added through the Pinterest window share one collection.
selectionCount: Selected pictures: {count}, before shape and word filters.
noCollections: No collection is selected. Wallpaper changes need at least one.
selectionApplied: Selection applied for your next wallpaper.
wordsHint: Separate words with commas. These filters read pin titles and descriptions, not image contents. Hide affects Pinpaper only; nothing is sent to Pinterest.
scheduleHint: Uses your computer’s time. Equal start and stop times mean all day. Closing the main window keeps Pinpaper in the menu bar or tray; Quit stops changes.
accountHint: Signing out closes Pinterest but keeps your pictures and settings. Reset also removes your local collection and preferences. Neither changes your Pinterest account.
resetConfirm: Remove all pictures and settings saved in Pinpaper? Your Pinterest account will not be changed.
galleryHint: Browse saved pin links. Only pictures used as wallpapers are downloaded, so this list stays light.
noMatches: No pictures match. Try another search or show hidden pictures.
noPictures: No pictures yet. Add some from Pinterest in Settings.
searchingFirst: Looking for a wallpaper… attempt {attempt} of {max}.
searchingNext: This picture did not work. Looking for the next wallpaper… attempt {attempt} of {max}.
errorNoPage: Open Pinterest from step 1, sign in, and open Home or a saved board before adding pictures.
errorNoPins: Scroll down in the Pinterest window and wait for pictures to load, then try adding them again.
errorFilters: Choose a collection in Settings or relax the picture filters, then try again.
previewOnly: Interface preview. Open the desktop app to use your pictures.
browserTitle: Pinterest — sign in and load pictures
minWidthHelp: Not every Pinterest picture is large enough for your screen. Lowering the minimum width makes more pictures available, but they may look less sharp.
errorForbidden: Pinterest refused this image download. Choose Change wallpaper again to try another picture. If this repeats, import the loaded Pinterest pictures again to refresh their links.
retrySearch: That picture could not be used. Pinpaper searched the next wallpapers and paused after its retry limit. Try again later or re-import the Pinterest pictures.
